title: Unit – 1 : Session – 11 : SLO – 2  |  Classification of System Calls — Match
sections: Used to start, end, or abort a process -> PROCESS CONTROL (create, terminate, load, execute).
Involves opening, reading, writing, and closing files -> FILE MANIPULATION (open, read, write, close).
Deals with request and release of hardware like printers or drives -> DEVICE MANIPULATION
(request device, release device, read, write, ioctl).
Includes getting system date, time, or system info -> INFORMATION MAINTENANCE (getpid, time, attributes).
Used when two processes exchange data or messages -> COMMUNICATION (pipe, shmget, send/receive, sockets).
Used to set permissions and access rights -> PROTECTION (chmod, umask, chown, access control).
